subject: Trading
title: Asymmetric Bets
description: A micro-lesson that makes Asymmetric Bets usable.

hook.text: Risk $1 to make $10. Lose nine times, win once, and you still profit. Asymmetric bets create outsized returns.

buildup.text: Asymmetric bets have a small, defined downside and a large, potentially unlimited upside.

discovery.text: George Soros's bet against the British pound risked relatively little but made over $1 billion. A 1:100+ payoff.

twist.text: Most asymmetric bets lose—that's the nature of low-probability, high-payoff trades. You need many at-bats.

climax.text: A portfolio of small asymmetric bets can produce extraordinary returns if just a few hit big.

punchline.text: Small risk, huge potential rewards. That's the ideal trade.

quiz.question: What defines an asymmetric bet?
options: Small defined downside with large potential upside
